title: NoMachine Tutorial
intro: Welcome to the NoMachine tutorial. Follow the steps below to get started.

steps.title: Step 1: Download NoMachine
steps.content: NoMachine is available for both Windows and MacOS, please visit the Wiki Socs to download the software.

steps.title: Step 2: Setup Configurations
steps.content: Follow the setup instructions provided on the website to set up NoMachine on your local machine.

steps.title: Step 3: Connect to the School's Linux Servers
steps.content: Open NoMachine, enter the IP address of the linux servers, and follow the prompts to connect to the school's linux servers.
